title: New Figma File: shared components and pages (templates/_shared.json)

components.description: Named library components, used in content as { "component": "<name>" }.

key.description: Key of the published library component. In the library file, select the component and run figma.currentPage.selection[0].key in the console.

fill.description: Code that fills it with form data (src/create/fillers.ts). Filled components are always detached.

detach.description: Detach instances after placing them (default false).

pages.description: Pages that several templates use, referenced by name from a template's "pages".
